external_entities.description: An external supplier providing documents and contact details.

processes.name: Supplier document portal
processes.description: A vendor-hosted portal receiving supplier documents and category manager decisions.

processes.name: Category manager
processes.description: A corporate category manager reviewing, approving, or rejecting supplier information in the portal.

processes.name: Supplier master service
processes.description: A service loading supplier data into the landing bucket and supplier database.

data_stores.name: Landing bucket
data_stores.description: A cloud storage location receiving supplier data extracts and loaded files.

data_flows.description: Supplier-provided documents and staff contact details sent to the supplier document portal.

data_flows.data_description: insurance certificates, food safety audits, staff contact details

data_flows.description: Category manager review and approval or rejection actions sent to the supplier document portal.

data_flows.description: A nightly CSV supplier data extract sent from the portal to the landing bucket.

trust_boundaries.name: Vendor platform (SaaS)
trust_boundaries.description: The vendor platform SaaS zone containing the supplier document portal.

trust_boundaries.name: Corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network zone containing the category manager.

trust_boundaries.name: Our cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud account zone containing the landing bucket, supplier master service, and supplier database.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier is an external system rather than a human actor.
assumptions.basis: The diagram names the actor 'Supplier' as a supplier organization providing records and documents.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier document portal presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: The component is explicitly named a 'portal'.

assumptions.assumption: The Vendor platform (SaaS) is controlled by a different party and is therefore a tenant boundary.
assumptions.basis: The zone is explicitly named 'Vendor platform (SaaS)'.

assumptions.assumption: The Corporate network is a network boundary.
assumptions.basis: The zone is explicitly named 'Corporate network'.

assumptions.assumption: Our cloud account is a network boundary distinct from the corporate network.
assumptions.basis: The diagram places cloud components in a separately named 'Our cloud account' zone, distinct from 'Corporate network'.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket contains confidential data because it receives supplier data extracts and files containing supplier records and staff contact details.
assumptions.basis: The bucket receives 'nightly supplier data extract (CSV)' and 'load file'; the supplied data includes 'staff contact details' and supplier records.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier database contains confidential data because it stores supplier records.
assumptions.basis: The diagram sends 'supplier records' to the supplier database, and supplier information includes staff contact details.
